title: Performance Reviews
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Estás preparado para dar y recibir evaluaciones de desempeño en inglés de forma asertiva.

parts.visual:
Desempeño positivo: 
- Meet expectations (Cumplir las expectativas). 
- Exceed expectations (Superar las expectativas). 
- Key strengths (Fortalezas clave). 
Ej: You consistently exceed expectations and your teamwork is a key strength.
parts.audio: Positive performance. Meet expectations means you did exactly what you needed to do. Exceed expectations means you did much better than required. Key strengths are your best abilities. For example: You consistently exceed expectations and your teamwork is a key strength.

parts.visual:
Áreas de mejora: 
- Room for improvement (Espacio / Margen para mejorar). 
- Weakness (Debilidad). 
- Set goals (Establecer metas). 
Ej: There is room for improvement in your communication skills, so let's set some goals for next quarter.
parts.audio: Areas for improvement. Room for improvement is a polite way to say you need to get better at something. Weakness. Set goals means to plan future achievements. For example: There is room for improvement in your communication skills, so let's set some goals for next quarter.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta para la evaluación de desempeño.

questions.question: Today we are going to have your annual performance ____. (Evaluación / Revisión).
questions.explanation: Performance review (o performance appraisal) = evaluación de desempeño.

questions.question: You always ____ expectations. You do exactly what is required. (Cumples).
questions.explanation: Meet expectations = cumplir con las expectativas.

questions.question: Your work this year was amazing. You ____ expectations! (Superaste).
questions.explanation: Exceed expectations = superar las expectativas (hacer más de lo esperado).

questions.question: Unfortunately, your performance fell ____ of expectations. (Se quedó corto / No cumplió).
questions.explanation: Fall short (of expectations) = quedarse corto, no cumplir.

questions.question: Leadership is one of your key ____. (Fortalezas).
However, time management is a ____ for you. (Debilidad).
Don't worry, there is always ____ for improvement. (Margen / Espacio).
questions.explanation: Room for improvement = margen de mejora.

questions.question: We need to ____ some clear goals for next year. (Establecer / Fijar).
You need to take more ____ in your projects. (Iniciativa).
questions.explanation: Take initiative = tomar la iniciativa (ser proactivo).

questions.question: Your ____ skills are excellent. Everyone loves working with you. (Trabajo en equipo).
questions.explanation: Teamwork skills = habilidades de trabajo en equipo.

questions.question: You showed great ____ to the company during the crisis. (Dedicación / Compromiso).
We will evaluate your ____ based on these metrics. (Desempeño / Rendimiento).
I appreciate your ____. It helps me grow. (Retroalimentación constructiva).
You need to improve your ____ management. You often miss deadlines. (Tiempo).
Because of your hard work, we are offering you a ____. (Ascenso).
questions.explanation: Promotion = ascenso de puesto. (Raise = aumento de sueldo).

questions.question: We are also giving you a salary ____ of 10%. (Aumento).
questions.explanation: Raise = aumento de salario (en inglés americano). En UK a veces usan 'rise'.

questions.question: You are a very ____ worker. I can always count on you. (Confiable).
questions.explanation: Reliable = confiable (alguien en quien se puede confiar para hacer el trabajo).

questions.question: You need to be more ____ and not wait for instructions. (Proactivo).
Your ____ is very positive. It motivates the team. (Actitud).
Let's review your ____ from last year. (Logros).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra correcta para la evaluación.

questions.question: Annual performance ____. (Revisión / Evaluación con R)
To ____ expectations. (Cumplir con M)
To ____ expectations. (Superar con E)
Key ____. (Fortalezas con S plural)
A ____. (Debilidad con W singular)
There is ____ for improvement. (Margen / Espacio con R)
To ____ goals. (Establecer con S)
A salary ____. (Aumento de sueldo con R)
A ____. (Ascenso de puesto con P)
Constructive ____. (Retroalimentación con F)
